candidate.title: G4-seq
candidate.scope: The middle G4-seq row of the assigned Illumina schematic: genomic DNA library on a flow cell, a reference sequencing pass, removal of the synthesized read strand, a second primer, alternative K+ or PDS stabilization, a second sequencing pass with depicted polymerase stalling, and comparison of the two reads. The upper Ribose-seq row, lower CAP-seq row, and chemical structures in the right-hand legend are adjacent context without depicted connections to this workflow. K+ and PDS are reagent alternatives within G4-seq, not separately named target methods. This is a schematic architecture, not a full experimental protocol.
